name: Help! I'm Turning Into A Mermaid!
source:
Hunter is having a very rough week. They've just started a new career as a police officer at the Axon City Police Department, except they've been trained as a conflict de-escalation officer and aren't allowed to carry any weaponry. This has not gone down well with their partner Ember, a fire elemental who usually solves problems by chucking a fireball at it and cleaning up the mess afterwards.

If workplace drama wasn't enough, the city has become embroiled in a massive conspiracy involving corrupt government officials, a cult of mysterious witches and an army of militarised pirates who want nothing more than to reduce the city to a smoking pile of ash.  Oh, and Hunter also appears to be slowly transforming into a mermaid! 

Will Hunter be able to work out what's going on with their transformation before it's too late and they wind up stuck as a woman forever? Probably not, but maybe they'll find a way back to their old self! There's a first time for everything, you never know!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4115180/Help_Im_Turning_Into_A_Mermaid/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
亨特度过了非常艰难的一周。他们刚刚开始在阿克森市警察局担任警官的新职业，但他们接受过冲突降级官员的培训，并且不允许携带任何武器。这对他们的搭档安珀来说并不好，安珀是一个火元素，通常通过向其扔火球并随后清理混乱来解决问题。

如果职场上的戏剧还不够，这座城市已经卷入了一场大规模阴谋，涉及腐败的政府官员、神秘女巫邪教和一支军事海盗大军，他们只想将这座城市化为一堆冒烟的灰烬。哦，猎人似乎也在慢慢变成美人鱼！

亨特能否在为时已晚之前弄清楚她们的转变是怎么回事，她们最终会永远被困在女人的身份中吗？可能不会，但也许他们会找到回到原来的自我的方法！凡事都有第一次，你永远不知道！

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4115180/Help_Im_Turning_Into_A_Mermaid/]Steam[/url]]
